# Checkmate Dynamics

> Checkmate Dynamics is a Dallas robotics and drone hardware company. It makes motion nodes, actuators and cycloidal gearboxes, sensors such as the Contour lidar, and hubs, for robot arms and robot training-data rigs; a flight-sensor node for drones is in development. Everything works together out of the box. Makers use the nodes one at a time, robotics companies build them in, and our data-station hardware is assembled from them. Prices are list prices in US dollars.

Specifications are datasheet figures, values set by our design, or bench measurements. Prices are list prices in USD. Legal notices and pre-order terms: https://checkmatedynamics.com/legal.md. Every page has a markdown version at the same address ending in .md.

## Overview

- [Home](https://checkmatedynamics.com/index.md): Dallas robotics and drone hardware company: motion nodes, actuators, cycloidal gearboxes, Contour lidar and hubs for robot arms and training-data rigs.
- [Products](https://checkmatedynamics.com/products.md): One family of complete motion, sensing and sync nodes in four groups: Move, Sense, Sync, Power and connect. Each works alone and joins the same bus.

## Products

- [SmartStepper 17](https://checkmatedynamics.com/smartstepper-17.md): A closed-loop NEMA 17 stepper node that sets up in a browser. Board, motor node, or with a 25:1 metal cycloidal reducer for a robot joint. Python SDK.
- [SmartServo G](https://checkmatedynamics.com/smartservo-g.md): A silent, backdrivable brushless servo node for 2804 and 5208 gimbal motors. Direct drive or cycloidal, with power and CAN-FD on one cable between nodes.
- [Contour](https://checkmatedynamics.com/contour.md): Metric depth from a time-of-flight lidar sensor the size of a thumb, on the same clock as your cameras. Contour, Contour Wrist and Contour OEM.
- [Hub 8 Pro](https://checkmatedynamics.com/hub-8.md): Eight node ports, each its own power source and CAN segment, with a hardware e-stop and one link to the host computer. Part of the Checkmate Leader.

## Stations

- [Sync Beacon](https://checkmatedynamics.com/sync-beacon.md): An LED clock your cameras film. It puts every frame on one clock and shows how far apart your cameras and joints are. Rent it for a 14-day check or own one.
- [Checkmate Leader](https://checkmatedynamics.com/leader.md): A leader arm that carries its own weight, lets the operator feel the follower’s limits and grip, and returns home by itself. Every joint is a SmartServo G node.
- [Stations](https://checkmatedynamics.com/stations.md): Sync QA, a motorized leader arm, commissioning and service for teleoperation stations, built from the nodes we sell on their own. Fewer rejected episodes.

## Ways in

- [Makers](https://checkmatedynamics.com/makers.md): Motor nodes with the driver, encoder, controller and gearbox built in. Plug in, open the app in a browser, move. Script from Python when ready.
- [Components](https://checkmatedynamics.com/components.md): For teams building their own arms, grippers, handhelds and rigs: the motion, sensing and sync nodes we use in our stations, with per-unit test records.
- [Contact](https://checkmatedynamics.com/contact.md): Makers register interest, data floors book a call, robotics companies talk to engineering. Write to the team at contact@checkmatedynamics.com.

## Company

- [Company](https://checkmatedynamics.com/company.md): Dallas robotics and drone hardware company making motion nodes, actuators, cycloidal gearboxes, lidar sensors and hubs for robot arms and data rigs.
